## Change types
Changes are classified as standard, normal or emergency. Standard changes are pre-approved and follow a published template.

## Change advisory board
The change advisory board meets every Tuesday at 10:00 UTC to review normal changes.

## Emergency changes
Emergency changes may be implemented with approval from the on-call manager and must be reviewed by the change advisory board within two business days.

## Change freeze
A change freeze applies from 15 December to 5 January each year. Only emergency changes are allowed during the freeze.
